observations: Black Canon EOS R6 mirrorless camera body.
The camera is shown with the lens cap attached.
The 'Canon' logo is visible on the front of the lens cap.
The 'EOS R6' model name is clearly printed on the front of the camera body.
The camera is resting on a wooden surface.
A watermark 'OLAJIDE AMOS BISHOP' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The camera is shown with a lens cap, but there is no clear view of the box or the interior of the body to confirm it is unopened.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The shutter may be near or past its 100,000 actuation limit.
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count from a recent image file or a shutter count tool.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high shutter count

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the image sensor may be dirty.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on and taking a clear photo.

risks.risk: The lens may be a third-party or different model than the body.
risks.proof: A photo of the lens barrel showing the brand and model.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the camera with the lens removed to check the sensor and the interior of the body.
Photo of the lens barrel to confirm the model.
Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
